name: VPN Check
author: brightwalker25
description: VPN and DNS posture at a glance: exit address, who hosts it, where DNS resolves, and whether anything is leaking

barWidget.description: Your real IP, the address the VPN gives you, who hosts it, where DNS resolves from, and a traffic light against each

schema.label: Re-check every (ms)
schema.description: How often the full checks re-run while the panel is open. While it is closed only the local check runs, once a minute, and it sends no packets.

schema.label: Lookup timeout (seconds)
schema.description: How long each outbound lookup may take before it is reported as unknown.

schema.label: ipinfo.io token
schema.description: Optional. Raises the anonymous rate limit on the address lookups. Leave empty to stay anonymous.
